mapper.insert: INSERT INTO weekly_work_schedule ( employee_id, start_date, end_date, approval_status, plan_date, work_form, schedule_title, memo, created_at ) VALUES ( #{employeeId}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{approvalStatus}, #{planDate}, #{workForm}, #{scheduleTitle}, #{memo}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT 1 FROM employee WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT weekly_id as weeklyId, employee_id as employeeId, start_date as startDate, end_date as endDate, approval_status as approvalStatus, plan_date as planDate, work_form as workForm, schedule_title as scheduleTitle, memo as memo, reject_reason as rejectReason, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM weekly_work_schedule WHERE weekly_id = #{weeklyId}

SELECT weekly_id as weeklyId, employee_id as employeeId, start_date as startDate, end_date as endDate, approval_status as approvalStatus, plan_date as planDate, work_form as workForm, schedule_title as scheduleTitle, memo as memo, reject_reason as rejectReason, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM weekly_work_schedule WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY start_date DESC, weekly_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT weekly_id as weeklyId, employee_id as employeeId, start_date as startDate, end_date as endDate, approval_status as approvalStatus, plan_date as planDate, work_form as workForm, schedule_title as scheduleTitle, memo as memo, reject_reason as rejectReason, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM weekly_work_schedule WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND plan_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY plan_date ASC, weekly_id ASC

SELECT weekly_id as weeklyId, employee_id as employeeId, start_date as startDate, end_date as endDate, approval_status as approvalStatus, plan_date as planDate, work_form as workForm, schedule_title as scheduleTitle, memo as memo, reject_reason as rejectReason, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM weekly_work_schedule WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND plan_date = #{planDate} AND approval_status = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY weekly_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE weekly_work_schedule SET approval_status = #{approvalStatus}, reject_reason = CASE WHEN #{approvalStatus} = 'REJECTED' THEN #{rejectReason} ELSE NULL END, updated_at = NOW() WHERE weekly_id = #{weeklyId} AND approval_status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT w.weekly_id as weeklyId, w.employee_id as employeeId, w.start_date as startDate, w.end_date as endDate, w.approval_status as approvalStatus, w.plan_date as planDate, w.work_form as workForm, w.schedule_title as scheduleTitle, w.memo as memo, w.reject_reason as rejectReason, e.employee_name as employeeName, COALESCE(o.org_name, '미소속') as departmentName, COALESCE(p.position_name, '직원') as positionName, w.created_at as createdAt, w.updated_at as updatedAt FROM weekly_work_schedule w JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id = w.employee_id LEFT JOIN employee_hr_info h ON h.employee_id = e.employee_id LEFT JOIN organization o ON o.org_id = h.org_id LEFT JOIN hr_position p ON p.position_id = h.position_id WHERE w.plan_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY w.plan_date ASC, e.employee_name ASC, w.weekly_id ASC

SELECT w.weekly_id as weeklyId, w.employee_id as employeeId, w.start_date as startDate, w.end_date as endDate, w.approval_status as approvalStatus, w.plan_date as planDate, w.work_form as workForm, w.schedule_title as scheduleTitle, w.memo as memo, w.reject_reason as rejectReason, e.employee_name as employeeName, COALESCE(o.org_name, '미소속') as departmentName, COALESCE(p.position_name, '직원') as positionName, w.created_at as createdAt, w.updated_at as updatedAt FROM weekly_work_schedule w JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id = w.employee_id LEFT JOIN employee_hr_info h ON h.employee_id = e.employee_id LEFT JOIN organization o ON o.org_id = h.org_id LEFT JOIN hr_position p ON p.position_id = h.position_id WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM employee_hr_info target_h WHERE target_h.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND target_h.org_id = h.org_id ) AND w.plan_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY w.plan_date ASC, e.employee_name ASC, w.weekly_id ASC
